name: Nyomár (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nyomár: a red shield with a white sabre, with a helm and crest, between green branches, above a scroll inscribed NYOMÁR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nyomár arms with helm, crest, branches and scroll
